tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window behind every panel, under the dot grid. Quarn's Black. With window blur on, it is drawn translucent so the desktop shows through, blurred.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The window behind the cards, at its lighter top-left: Saturn's own deep blue, the same over any desktop. Runs into `backdrop-deep`.

tokens.name: backdrop-deep
tokens.usage: The window behind the cards, at its deeper bottom-right.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content wells: the terminal, the editor text, the lists in the sidebar. The darker inside of every panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels: the sidebar, the editor and each terminal pane. Holds the tabs and controls; its content sits in a `surface` well.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, inputs, the segmented track.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of anything on `control`.

tokens.name: control-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed, and the selected segment or tab.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel and card edges, toolbar dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons, the dot grid, the corner brackets of the focused pane.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, names, icons. Not pure white: Quarn's grey-white keeps the black calm.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text and terminal output. Quarn's Grey (#D1D1D1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Second lines, paths, inactive tabs. 7.9:1 or more in dark, 7:1 or more in light; clearly above `ink-faint`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, line numbers, idle marks. At least 4.8:1 on every dark surface and 4.5:1 on every light one, so it is still text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill: the selected pill.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `blue-vivid` fills and the accent gradient (5:1), in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on `amber` fills (11:1), in both themes.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The accent as text or a mark: the working dot, links, the focused pane's ring. 10:1 on dark `surface`, 6:1 on light.

tokens.name: blue-vivid
tokens.usage: The bright stop of the blue gradient and solid blue fills that carry white text.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: The dark stop of the blue gradient. Quarn's Brand (#0C3F09), turned blue. Never on its own.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: A warm fill: the chip and count badges. Same in both themes, always with `ink-on-signal` text (11:1).

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Warm text and marks that aren't status: numbers in code, git M. Darkened in light mode (5.4:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Needs you: an agent is waiting on a question, a permission prompt, or stopped. Darkened in light mode for contrast: 5.3:1 on `surface`, 4.7:1 on the glass. A hidden tab that needs you is filled with it, white text in light mode and `ink-on-signal` in dark.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (close a running agent). Always with a word or icon. In dark mode it sits at the palette's lightness and saturation (OKLCH 0.78 / 0.13, like blue and green), 7.9:1 on `surface`; a red fill there takes `ink-on-signal` text.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working: Claude is thinking or running tools.

tokens.name: status-needs-you
tokens.usage: Needs you: a permission prompt or a question is open, or the turn stopped. Orange.

tokens.name: status-your-turn
tokens.usage: Your turn: the turn finished with nothing pending. Green: done and safe to read, unlike orange, which is waiting on you.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error: the turn failed.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle: a plain shell, or Claude with no turn started.

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI black.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI red.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI green (diff additions, passing tests). Darkened in light mode: 5.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI yellow.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI blue; the accent.

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI magenta.

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI cyan.

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI white and the default foreground; matches `ink-body`.

color.note: Cyberdeck is the second theme: true greys on an opaque near-black (or near-white) ground, its own saturated signal colours, neon on the dark ground and deep on the light, meaning what Saturn's mean. A token without its own Cyberdeck value uses Saturn's in the same appearance.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and the empty window. Light, with the key words in 600: the two weights in one line are the signature.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Empty states and dialog titles; key words may take 600.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Card, agent and project names, in Medium (500).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Open a shell in the project folder
styles.usage: Default interface text. Urbanist runs small, so the body is 14, not 13.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, segments, chips. Medium (500): semibold is too heavy at this size.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The second line under a name, in `ink-muted`: Quarn's 'Tools Agent' under 'AI Agent'.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: A count on a button's corner (the filters set), on a 14px badge.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Between a row and its arrow key (6 − 2 = 4).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: A container's padding around its controls: pane frames, panels, tracks (10 − 4 = 6).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on `ground`, and from the panels to the window's edge (16 − 6 = 10).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of floating panels (14 − 8 = 6); gaps inside toolbars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Text padding inside cards; terminal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Generous padding around text blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Around an empty state's headline.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, keys and the arrow key at the end of a row: 2px inside a `radius-sm` row (6 − 2).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything you click: buttons, icon buttons, tabs, segments, rows, inputs; and the terminal card. 4px inside a `radius-md` container (10 − 4).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, pane frames, the toolbar and segmented tracks: 6px inside the macOS window corner (about 16 − 6).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Things that float over the grid: dialogs, the command palette, the gradient card. They pad 8px, so what is inside them is `radius-sm` (14 − 8).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and count badges only.

radius.note: Derived from the outside in: the macOS window corner (about 16) minus the 6px gap gives panels 10; minus 4px padding gives controls 6; minus 2px gives chips 4. Nothing inside the window is rounder than the window.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the command palette: anything that floats over the grid.

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: The focused pane: a thin blue ring and a soft bloom, like Quarn's lit connectors.

tokens.name: glow-needs-you
tokens.usage: A pane that needs you (a question, a permission, or stopped) and has not been looked at: an orange ring, lit and still. Wins over the others.

tokens.name: glow-your-turn
tokens.usage: A pane whose turn finished with nothing pending and has not been looked at: a green ring.

themes.note: A theme is a description, not code: the font, how corners are drawn, how far apart cards sit, and which version of each control it uses. Every component reads its theme's choices and never asks which theme is on, so a new theme is one more entry here, plus its own colour values (`<id>-dark` and `<id>-light` on any colour that differs; the rest borrow Saturn's). The first theme is the default, and its colours are the plain `dark` and `light` values. `controlColumn` is the width every setting's control is given, right-aligned, so the words beside them wrap at one place: wide enough for the theme's widest choice. `iconSwaps` draws another Lucide icon in place of one the theme finds too round, where Lucide has an angular one that means the same.

corners.round: Rounded by the radius tokens, nested from the window inward.
corners.cut: Square, with a corner cut off panels (`panelCut`) and selections and buttons (`controlCut`).

surfaces.glass: The window's glass shows between translucent cards.
surfaces.opaque: Opaque cards on an opaque ground.

titleBar.tracks: The title bar's controls sit in tracks on the cards' surface.
titleBar.bare: They stand bare, filling the bar but for the gap between cards.

tabs.track: Tabs are track items, the chosen one raised.
tabs.underline: Tabs are words over a bar, lit under the chosen one.

selection.raised: A chosen track item is raised: white in light mode, lighter in dark.
selection.outline: An ink outline round a faint fill, its corner cut.

choices.segments: A choice of a few values is a track of segments.
choices.selector: The value between two arrows, over a dash for each value.

switch.box: The word, then a box whose block sits right and lit, or left and dim.

buttons.filled: Filled; the primary one in the accent gradient with a bloom.
buttons.outline: An outline with its corner cut; the primary one blue, its words blue too.

menus.fill: The line under the pointer fills.
menus.outline: The line under the pointer is outlined.

settingRows.slabs: Each setting is its own slab, notched along its top.

meters.dots: Usage meters are rows of square dots.

agentCards.gradient: An agent's card has a soft gradient.
agentCards.slab: An agent's card is a flat grey slab.

currentLine.fill: The editor's current line is filled.

icons.round: Lucide as drawn: round line ends and joins, rounded corners.
icons.sharp: The same icons with square line ends, mitred joins, square corners, and small dots as squares.

themes.name: Saturn
themes.description: Saturn's own look: glass between rounded cards, in Urbanist.

themes.name: Cyberdeck
themes.description: Square panels with cut corners on an opaque ground, true greys, in a narrower face.

tone.note: How strong a relative fill or stroke is: black in light mode, white in dark (`theme::tone`), so it reads on any surface. From the faintest wash to an outline that stands out.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: A tint under a group, barely there: a diagram's frame, an outlined button's inside.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: An unchecked box's inside, a setting's slab, a hovered outline's inside.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Under the pointer, on what can be clicked.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: A track's fill: controls that belong together.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: A control's own fill, and a card's edge.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and parts; a floating card's edge in Saturn's theme.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed, open, or chosen in dark mode's tracks: a selection's outline fill too.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: A divider in a track; a raised item in dark mode; an empty meter dot.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: A cut panel's edge.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Marks that must show without colour: a checkbox's edge, a switch's dim block, a selector's spent arrow and dashes.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: An outlined button, selector or switch; a floating cut card's edge.

tokens.name: outline-strong
tokens.usage: An outline under the pointer.

icon.note: Icon sizes (Lucide, drawn at 1.5px). Small in strips and lists, regular in controls.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Beside a count or in a chip.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: In tabs, lists, the status bar and menus.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: In a 28px control: icon buttons, the folder's mark.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: On its own, as a mark.

size.note: Sizes things are drawn at, so the same thing is the same size everywhere.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Every control's height: buttons, fields, tabs, track items, menu lines, list rows.

tokens.name: control-small
tokens.usage: A control inside another: a tab's close button.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A list's row: files, changes, history, impact.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: A small mark: unsaved, changed, a server's state.

tokens.name: dot-large
tokens.usage: An agent's state.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: The title bar, macOS's buttons on its middle line.

tokens.name: titlebar-control
tokens.usage: A control in the title bar's tracks.

tokens.name: dialog-small
tokens.usage: A dialog with a field and a few words: new file, the welcome.

tokens.name: dialog-medium
tokens.usage: A dialog with a list: palette, new agent, waiting, broadcast.

tokens.name: dialog-large
tokens.usage: A dialog with two panes or a table: settings, sessions, worktrees, routines.
